references.text: Detailed instructions for the grain offering and drink offering that were to accompany the burnt offering - the amount of flour, oil, and wine required for each type of animal (bull, ram, lamb).
The drink offering associated with the daily burnt offering, which forms the basis for the sacrifice regulations repeated in chapter 29.
The grain offering and drink offering at the New Moon festival, using the same phrasing 'according to the statute' (כַּמִּשְׁפָּט) for the quantities.
The same regulation for the grain offering and drink offering on the first day of the seventh month, with identical wording.
The same phrasing is used for the third day of the Feast of Tabernacles - grain offering and drink offering according to the statute.
Repeated phrasing for the sixth day of the Feast of Tabernacles with the same sacrifice regulations.
Summary of the Lord's appointed feasts with burnt offerings, grain offerings, peace offerings, and drink offerings, each on its designated day.
Ezra resumed the celebration of the Feast of Tabernacles with the daily burnt offering in the correct number according to the statute.
